assertions.name: q_integer_truncates_at_root_of_unity
assertions.source: [κ]_q = 0 exactly at q = e^{iπ/κ} for every κ in 2..8 — the WRT/Verlinde truncation that makes the q-Laplacian spectrum finite and exact at roots of unity.

assertions.name: golden_ratio_at_kappa5
assertions.source: [3]_q at q=e^{iπ/5} equals the golden ratio φ=(1+√5)/2, the Fibonacci-anyon quantum dimension — the truncated spectrum is exact ADE/Verlinde data.

description: Exact root-of-unity truncation of the q-integer eigenvalue tower [k]_q — the shared spectral engine of the q-Laplacian (q-heat ∂_t=−Δ_q, q-Navier-Stokes Δ_q) and the Wenzl/Gram-matrix block dimensions. At q=e^{iπ/κ} the q-integer [κ]_q vanishes (WRT/Verlinde truncation), making the infinite q-Laplacian spectrum FINITE and exact. Records the surviving quantum dimensions [1]_q..[κ−1]_q (incl. the golden ratio at κ=5 = Fibonacci anyon dim), the q-heat mode-decay rates [k]_q², and the bar involution k↦−k ([k]_q²  bar-even = physical). Fibre-level (q formal, Im unconstrained); reality only at q₀. Exact symbolic; characterizes the shared engine, does not solve the q-NS PDE or build the q-heat archimedean realisation.
